items.title: Phil Flanigan interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 15, 1998
items.q: we went over to catch Jimmy. And we sat down and then he finished his set and he came over and he goes, “Hey, what are all you guys doing in town?”

ctx.x: Yeah, and be part of it.

But you don’t really want to hang out with them you know? There’s some that way and he was one of them. I mean to give you an idea, we were playing in L.A. one time, and we were staying at the Ambassador, and Jimmy Rowles was playing I guess it was a solo gig. It may have been Dante’s, but I think it may have been somewhere else, I can’t recall. It was in the early ‘80s. And a bunch of us, including Scott Hamilton, Warren Vache and I think probably Cal Collins, Connie Kay, those were the kind of people that were…
He was pretty much, just strange.
